tools.name: openlinear_list_workspaces
tools.title: List workspaces
tools.description: List the workspaces this token can reach, with your role and member/project counts. A workspace-bound token sees only its workspace.

tools.name: openlinear_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects you can access, newest first. Filter by workspace or team, or by a case-insensitive match on name/key.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Case-insensitive match on project name or key

tools.name: openlinear_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Get one project with its teams, repository and labels (phase labels are parsed into `phase`). List the project's issues with openlinear_list_issues.

tools.name: openlinear_create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: Create a project with default labels and its own team (issue numbering), or adopt one existing team via teamIds. To create a project together with phases and issues, use openlinear_bulk_create_plan instead. Identical calls within 24 hours return the same project.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: Issue key prefix (e.g. "AUTH" gives AUTH-1); generated from the name if omitted

inputs.name: workspaceId
inputs.description: Defaults to your default workspace (or the token's bound workspace)

inputs.name: teamIds
inputs.description: Optional: move this one existing team (and its issue numbering) into the new project instead of creating a default team. Needs owner/admin on the team; it must be in the same workspace, not the last team of its project and have no issues there (else TEAM_PROJECT_CONFLICT with per-team reasons, nothing created)

tools.name: openlinear_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List teams (each belongs to one project and numbers its issues, e.g. ENG-12) with their members. Member user ids are the values assignee fields accept.

tools.name: openlinear_create_team
tools.title: Create team
tools.description: Create a team inside a project. Projects already get a default team, so only add one to split issue numbering. Identical calls within 24 hours return the same team.

inputs.name: key
inputs.description: Issue prefix, letters/digits starting with a letter; stored uppercase

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: Icon name shown in the UI

inputs.name: private
inputs.description: Hide the team from non-members (default false)

tools.name: openlinear_list_labels
tools.title: List labels and phases
tools.description: List the labels of a project. Phase labels ("phase:N — Name") carry a parsed `phase`; set phasesOnly to list just the phases.

inputs.name: phasesOnly
inputs.description: Return only phase labels, ordered by phase number

tools.name: openlinear_create_label
tools.title: Create label
tools.description: Create a label in a project, or return the existing label with the same name (created: false). For phases use openlinear_create_phase.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Label name, unique within the project

tools.name: openlinear_create_phase
tools.title: Create phase
tools.description: Create the phase label "phase:N — Name" in a project (or return it if it exists). Attach it to issues via labelIds to group them by phase.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: Defaults to a fixed 10-colour palette by phase number

tools.name: openlinear_search
tools.title: Search
tools.description: Case-insensitive text search across every issue, project and team you can access (titles, descriptions, keys, identifiers such as ENG-12), most recently updated first. Then use openlinear_get_issue or openlinear_get_project.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Text to look for (at least 2 characters)

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Total results, split across the requested types

tools.name: openlinear_list_issues
tools.title: List issues
tools.description: List issues newest first. Every filter runs on the server and they combine with AND: project, team, assignee ("me", "none" or a UUID), creator, status, labels, parent (sub-issues, or "none" for top-level only) and text. To page, call again with the same filters and cursor = nextCursor. For search across projects and teams use openlinear_search.

inputs.name: teamId
inputs.description: Team UUID: the team's issues, with or without a project

inputs.name: labelId
inputs.description: Label (or phase label) UUID, or up to 20 of them: an issue matches if it has any

inputs.name: parentId
inputs.description: Parent issue UUID (its sub-issues), or "none" for top-level issues only

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Case-insensitive literal text in the title, description or identifier

inputs.name: cursor
inputs.description: nextCursor from the previous page (opaque); keep every other argument unchanged

inputs.name: includeTotal
inputs.description: Also count every matching issue (one more query on the server)

tools.name: openlinear_get_issue
tools.title: Get issue
tools.description: Get one issue by taskId or identifier (e.g. ENG-12) with its description, parent issue, latest comments, sub-issues and latest verification evidence.

inputs.name: identifier
inputs.description: Issue identifier such as ENG-12; used when taskId is omitted. Refused, with the candidate taskIds, when it may match more than one issue (teams in different workspaces can share a key)

inputs.name: includeVerification
inputs.description: Include the latest verification evidence (checks run against the agent's commit)

tools.name: openlinear_find_similar_issues
tools.title: Find similar issues
tools.description: Before creating an issue, find open issues in the project whose title is similar (likely duplicates), best match first. Read-only.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: The title you are about to create

tools.name: openlinear_create_issue
tools.title: Create issue
tools.description: Create one issue in a project (or in a team, without a project), optionally with labels and assignees. Safe to retry: identical calls within 24 hours return the original issue (idempotency.replayed: true) instead of a duplicate. For many issues use openlinear_bulk_create_plan.

inputs.name: projectId
inputs.description: Project (its default team numbers the issue). projectId or teamId is required

inputs.name: teamId
inputs.description: Team, for an issue without a project (such issues take no labels); ignored when projectId is given

inputs.name: labelIds
inputs.description: Label UUIDs from the same project, including phase labels

inputs.name: assigneeIds
inputs.description: Assignees: "me" or user UUIDs of members of the issue team (openlinear_list_teams); the first is the primary assignee shown on the board

inputs.name: agent
inputs.description: Agent runner that executes the issue; omit or null for the project's default

inputs.name: idempotencyKey
inputs.description: Optional. Identical calls are already de-duplicated; pass a new value only to deliberately create another identical item.

tools.name: openlinear_update_issue
tools.title: Update issue
tools.description: Change fields of one issue; omitted fields are left as they are. labelIds REPLACES the whole label set (use openlinear_label_issue to add or remove). projectId moves the issue to that project's default team; null detaches it.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: New markdown description; null clears it

inputs.name: status
inputs.description: Moving to todo, done or cancelled resets execution state

inputs.name: projectId
inputs.description: Move to this project (its default team); null detaches

inputs.name: dueDate
inputs.description: ISO 8601 UTC due date; null clears it

inputs.name: assigneeId
inputs.description: Must be a member of the issue team; null unassigns

inputs.name: agent
inputs.description: Agent runner; null falls back to the project's default

tools.name: openlinear_assign_issue
tools.title: Assign issue
tools.description: Assign an issue to "me" (the token owner) or a user UUID, or pass null to unassign. The user must be a member of the issue team (see openlinear_list_teams).

inputs.name: assignee
inputs.description: "me", a user UUID, or null to unassign

tools.name: openlinear_label_issue
tools.title: Add or remove issue labels
tools.description: Add and/or remove labels (including phase labels) on one issue without touching its other labels. Each label is attached or detached on its own (no overwrite race); labels must belong to the issue's project.

tools.name: openlinear_set_blockers
tools.title: Add or remove issue blockers
tools.description: Mark an issue as blocked by other issues of the same project, or remove such blockers. A blocked issue waits: agent runs of it are refused until every blocker is done, and batches run blockers first. Loops are refused (DEPENDENCY_CYCLE). Each blocker is added or removed on its own; re-adding one is a no-op.

inputs.name: add
inputs.description: Issue UUIDs that must be done first

inputs.name: remove
inputs.description: Issue UUIDs that no longer block it

tools.name: openlinear_bulk_update_status
tools.title: Move issues to a status
tools.description: Set the status of up to 100 listed issues in one call (e.g. move a phase to done), scoped to one project or to one team's issues without a project. Only the listed taskIds change; issues already in that status are reported as unchanged.

inputs.name: projectId
inputs.description: Change issues of this project; pass projectId or teamId

inputs.name: teamId
inputs.description: Change this team's issues that have no project (created with only a teamId); pass projectId or teamId

inputs.name: taskIds
inputs.description: Issue UUIDs, all in the chosen project or team scope

inputs.name: status
inputs.description: todo, done and cancelled reset execution state

tools.name: openlinear_add_comment
tools.title: Add comment
tools.description: Add a markdown comment to an issue. @username mentions notify users who can see the issue. Not idempotent: each call adds a comment.

tools.name: openlinear_bulk_create_plan
tools.title: Create project plan
tools.description: Create a project, one "phase:N — Name" label per phase and every task (as todo issues) in one call: the fastest way to turn a multi-phase plan into OpenLinear issues. Not atomic: the result lists exactly what was created; on status "partial", call again with identical arguments within 24 hours to finish it without duplicates.

inputs.name: workspaceId
inputs.description: Defaults to your default workspace (or the token's bound workspace)

inputs.name: teamId
inputs.description: Optional: move this existing team (and its issue numbering) into the new project instead of creating a default team. Needs owner/admin on the team; it must be in the same workspace, not the last team of its project and have no issues there (else TEAM_PROJECT_CONFLICT, nothing created)

inputs.name: phases
inputs.description: Ordered phases; phase N becomes the label "phase:N — Name"

inputs.name: idempotencyKey
inputs.description: Optional. Identical calls are already de-duplicated; pass a new value only to deliberately create another identical item.

tools.name: openlinear_list_plans
tools.title: List plans
tools.description: List a project's reviewable plans with their status and progress (newest activity first). Check here before proposing a plan that may already exist.

tools.name: openlinear_propose_plan
tools.title: Propose a plan for review
tools.description: Propose a plan for a project as a draft people review in OpenLinear: tasks with acceptance checks, estimates and blockers (by key). It is checked first (duplicate keys, unknown blockers and loops are refused; tasks without acceptance checks or estimates are flagged). Nothing is created until the plan is approved. Revise it with openlinear_revise_plan. Safe to retry.

inputs.name: tasks
inputs.description: The whole task list (1-100), blockers by key

inputs.name: note
inputs.description: Why this revision (shown in its history)

inputs.name: idempotencyKey
inputs.description: Optional. Identical calls are already de-duplicated; pass a new value only to deliberately create another identical item.

tools.name: openlinear_get_plan
tools.title: Get plan
tools.description: Get a plan with one revision (the latest by default): its tasks, checks, changes against the previous revision, and the issues approvals created.

inputs.name: revision
inputs.description: Revision number; defaults to the latest

tools.name: openlinear_revise_plan
tools.title: Revise a plan
tools.description: Store a new revision of a plan (the full task list; keep keys stable so approved issues are updated, not duplicated). baseRevision must be the latest revision (else PLAN_REVISION_CONFLICT: read the plan again). An identical task list adds no revision.

inputs.name: tasks
inputs.description: The whole task list (1-100), blockers by key

tools.name: openlinear_approve_plan
tools.title: Approve a plan
tools.description: Approve the latest revision of a plan — only when the user asked for it. Creates the issues for new keys, applies what the plan changed since the last approval (edits made on the issues are kept), and syncs blockers between plan issues. Approving the same revision again changes nothing. Nothing is executed.

tools.name: openlinear_list_schedules
tools.title: List recurring issues
tools.description: List a project's recurring-issue schedules: what each creates, when (cadence in words, next run) and whether it is paused. Check here before creating one that may already exist.

tools.name: openlinear_create_schedule
tools.title: Create a recurring issue
tools.description: Create an issue automatically on a schedule in a project: every day, every weekday (Mon-Fri), every week on a weekday, or every month on a day (1-28), at a local time in an IANA time zone (daylight saving handled). Each run creates one issue from the template; it never runs the issue. A project has at most 25 active schedules. Safe to retry.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Issue title; {date} becomes each issue date (YYYY-MM-DD in the schedule time zone)

inputs.name: priority
inputs.description: Priority of each created issue (default medium)

inputs.name: assigneeId
inputs.description: A member of the project's team

inputs.name: cadence
inputs.description: daily, weekdays (Mon-Fri), weekly (needs weekday) or monthly (needs dayOfMonth)

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Berlin or America/New_York

inputs.name: idempotencyKey
inputs.description: Optional. Identical calls are already de-duplicated; pass a new value only to deliberately create another identical item.

tools.name: openlinear_list_knowledge
tools.title: List project knowledge
tools.description: List a project's knowledge: the conventions, procedures and notes the team wrote or approved (every agent run in the project is given the active ones), plus proposals waiting for a person. Read it before working in a project, and before proposing something that already exists.

tools.name: openlinear_propose_knowledge
tools.title: Propose project knowledge
tools.description: Propose a convention, procedure or note that every future agent run in a project should know (e.g. "Use pnpm, never npm"). It is saved as a proposal: nothing changes for agents until a person approves it in OpenLinear (project → Knowledge). Write a general, lasting rule, not a one-off instruction; use it when the user asks you to remember something. Safe to retry.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.description: convention (a rule the code follows), procedure (steps), note (context); default note

inputs.name: idempotencyKey
inputs.description: Optional. Identical calls are already de-duplicated; pass a new value only to deliberately create another identical item.

tools.name: openlinear_get_insights
tools.title: Get insights
tools.description: How agent work and delivery are going in a project or workspace over the last 7, 30 or 90 days: agent runs (succeeded / failed / cancelled / needs recovery / in progress), success, verification and pull request rates, median and p90 duration, known cost and tokens (runs without a price are counted in unknownCostRuns, never as $0), by runner and model; issues created vs completed, cycle time, blocked now, plan approvals. Read-only.

inputs.name: projectId
inputs.description: Insights for this project; pass projectId or workspaceId

inputs.name: workspaceId
inputs.description: Insights for the projects of this workspace you can read; pass projectId or workspaceId

inputs.name: range
inputs.description: Window ending now (default 30d); days are UTC

inputs.name: includeDaily
inputs.description: Also return one point per day (default false)
